cardmember_claim.text: The dining chairs I received are not what was advertised. The listing said solid oak frame with a walnut finish. What arrived is much lighter in colour and one chair has a visible seam in the backrest that isn't in any of the product photos. I emailed photos to the seller and they said it's 'natural timber variation'. It isn't what I paid for.

merchant_evidence.content:
VERANO FURNITURE - ORDER VF-51902
Date: 21/06/2026
Item: Aldrin Dining Chair, Walnut - set of 2
TOTAL AUD 690.00  |  Delivered 02/07/2026, signature obtained

ALDRIN DINING CHAIR - Solid oak frame, walnut stain finish. Handcrafted. Please note: as each chair is made from natural timber, grain, tone and joinery detail will vary between pieces. Images are indicative.
Two images supplied by merchant of the dispatched chairs prior to shipping. Frames appear walnut-toned; a joinery seam is visible on the backrest of one chair in image VF-51902-b.jpg.

[05/07 11:22] Customer: These don't match the listing photos, attaching pictures.
[06/07 10:04] Support: Thanks for the photos. This is within our stated natural timber variation. We can offer a 15% credit or a return under our 14-day policy.
[06/07 12:40] Customer: 15% doesn't cover it. I want a full refund.
[07/07 09:15] Support: A return is available until 16 July for a full refund minus return freight.
[No return initiated; dispute filed 11/07]

ground_truth.why: Merchant disclosed timber variation and offered remedy within policy (both 4553 defences), but the cardmember's seam complaint is a specific defect claim the disclosure may not cover. Evidence quality is comparable on both sides; confidence falls below threshold.
